lemmas.lemma: sette bukken til å passe havresekken
lemmas.primary_translation: put someone in charge of something they can be expected to exploit for their own benefit

word_forms.word_form: sette bukken til å passe havresekken

definitions.text: sette en person til å passe på eller gjøre noe som en må vente han eller hun vil dra fordel av
definitions.translation: put a person in charge of guarding or doing something when they can be expected to exploit it for their own benefit (lit. set the billy goat to guard the sack of oats)
